item.title: Switchy 1.4.0
item.description:
• Window layouts: click a preset beside the switcher's search, press its number, or build your own in Settings
  • Window keys move, focus and zoom windows within a layout, and move keys carry a window on to the next display
  • New windows join their app's zone, and windows return to their display when it reconnects
  • Hide rarely used menu bar icons behind an arrow
  • Agent threads: see which Claude and Codex threads need you, and open them from the menu bar
  • A shorter Switchy menu
  • Switchy now updates itself
